### Part 4: Calculating Gerrymandering
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

votes <- read_csv("data/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec_clean.csv")

district_results <- votes |>
  group_by(cddist) |>
  summarise(
    V_D = sum(cngdem01, cngdem02, na.rm = TRUE), 
    V_R = sum(cngrep01, cngrep02, na.rm = TRUE)  
  ) |>
  mutate(
    V_T = V_D + V_R, 
    S_D = V_D / V_T 
  ) |>
  # Filter vote=0
  filter(V_T > 0) |>
  ungroup()

# Mean-Median Score
total_v_t_statewide <- sum(district_results$V_T)
total_v_d_statewide <- sum(district_results$V_D)
mean_vote_share <- total_v_d_statewide / total_v_t_statewide

median_vote_share <- median(district_results$S_D, na.rm = TRUE)

mean_median_score <- mean_vote_share - median_vote_share

cat(sprintf("Mean Democratic Vote Share: %.4f\n", mean_vote_share))
cat(sprintf("Median Democratic Vote Share: %.4f\n", median_vote_share))
cat(sprintf("Mean-Median Score: %.4f\n", mean_median_score))

# Efficiency Gap
district_results <- district_results |>
  mutate(
    threshold = ceiling(V_T / 2),
    D_Win = V_D > V_R, 
    R_Win = V_R > V_D  
  )

district_results <- district_results |>
  mutate(
    W_D = case_when(
      D_Win == TRUE ~ V_D - threshold,
      D_Win == FALSE ~ V_D,
      TRUE ~ 0 
    ),
    W_R = case_when(
      R_Win == TRUE ~ V_R - threshold,
      R_Win == FALSE ~ V_R,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )

W_D_total <- sum(district_results$W_D)
W_R_total <- sum(district_results$W_R)

efficiency_gap_abs <- abs(W_D_total - W_R_total) / total_v_t_statewide

efficiency_gap_signed <- (W_R_total - W_D_total) / total_v_t_statewide

gap_favors <- ifelse(W_D_total < W_R_total, "Democratic Party (D)", "Republican Party (R)")

cat(sprintf("Total Wasted Votes - Democratic: %s\n", format(W_D_total, big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("Total Wasted Votes - Republican: %s\n", format(W_R_total, big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("Efficiency Gap: %.4f\n", efficiency_gap_abs))
cat(sprintf("Efficiency Gap: %.4f\n", efficiency_gap_signed))

```

### Part 6: Calculating Gerrymanding Again
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

ab604_results <- read_csv("ab604_results.csv") |>
  
  mutate(across(c(DEM_VOTES, REP_VOTES, TOTAL_VOTES, DEM_SHARE), as.numeric)) |>
  
  filter(TOTAL_VOTES > 0)

total_v_t_statewide_ab604 <- sum(ab604_results$TOTAL_VOTES)
total_v_d_statewide_ab604 <- sum(ab604_results$DEM_VOTES)
mean_vote_share_ab604 <- total_v_d_statewide_ab604 / total_v_t_statewide_ab604

# Median Vote Share
median_vote_share_ab604 <- median(ab604_results$DEM_SHARE, na.rm = TRUE)

#
mean_median_score_ab604 <- mean_vote_share_ab604 - median_vote_share_ab604

cat(sprintf("Mean Democratic Vote Share: %.4f\n", mean_vote_share_ab604))
cat(sprintf("Median Democratic Vote Share: %.4f\n", median_vote_share_ab604))
cat(sprintf("Mean-Median Score: %.4f\n", mean_median_score_ab604))


# Efficiency Gap
ab604_metrics <- ab604_results|>
  mutate(
    threshold = ceiling(TOTAL_VOTES / 2),
    D_Win = DEM_VOTES > REP_VOTES,
    R_Win = REP_VOTES > DEM_VOTES
  )

ab604_metrics <- ab604_metrics|>
  mutate(
    
    W_D = case_when(
      D_Win == TRUE ~ DEM_VOTES - threshold,
      D_Win == FALSE ~ DEM_VOTES,
      TRUE ~ 0 
    ),
    
    W_R = case_when(
      R_Win == TRUE ~ REP_VOTES - threshold,
      R_Win == FALSE ~ REP_VOTES,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )


W_D_total_ab604 <- sum(ab604_metrics$W_D)
W_R_total_ab604 <- sum(ab604_metrics$W_R)


efficiency_gap_abs_ab604 <- abs(W_D_total_ab604 - W_R_total_ab604) / total_v_t_statewide_ab604


efficiency_gap_signed_ab604 <- (W_R_total_ab604 - W_D_total_ab604) / total_v_t_statewide_ab604

gap_favors_ab604 <- ifelse(W_D_total_ab604 < W_R_total_ab604, "Democratic Party (D)", "Republican Party (R)")

cat(sprintf("Total Wasted Votes - Democratic: %s\n", format(W_D_total_ab604, big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("Total Wasted Votes - Republican: %s\n", format(W_R_total_ab604, big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("Efficiency Gap: %.4f\n", efficiency_gap_abs_ab604))
cat(sprintf("The Efficiency Gap favors the: %s\n", gap_favors_ab604))
cat(sprintf("Efficiency Gap: %.4f\n", efficiency_gap_signed_ab604))


```
